correctness.rationale: The total graph of a connected complete multipartite graph has diameter at most two, so every packing-total color above color one is unique and \(\chi''_\rho(G)=|V(G)|+|E(G)|-\alpha(T(G))+1\). A total-graph independent set is exactly a vertex set \(P\) together with a matching in \(G-P\); replacing any competing part by a largest part does not decrease the objective, yielding \(\alpha(T(G))=n_1+\nu(G-V_1)\) and the displayed closed formula. For edge deletion, the proof constructs a maximum such independent set avoiding any chosen edge except when the graph is \(K_{n,1,1}\) and the deleted edge joins the singleton parts. In that exceptional case deleting the edge produces \(K_{n,2}\) and the formula gives equality of the packing-total chromatic numbers. Monotonicity then upgrades edge-deletion strictness to all proper subgraphs. The assigned exhaustive verifier checks all complete multipartite types through order eight and isolates exactly the claimed exceptions.
residual_risks: The theorem concerns ordinary packing-total coloring, not arbitrary \(S\)-packing total colorings.
